tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Browse the complete Corpus Systemics therapy content catalog. Returns available skills (25-100 sats) and 12-week recovery trajectories (150 sats) for post-concussion, post-COVID, burnout and chronic stress.

tools.name: assess
tools.description: Assess client symptoms and recommend Corpus Systemics therapy content for post-concussion, post-COVID, burnout or chronic stress.

tools.name: preview
tools.description: Retrieve a free preview of a therapy trajectory before purchase. Returns first session content and expected outcomes.

tools.name: buy_skill
tools.description: Purchase a single therapy skill via Bitcoin Lightning Network (25-100 satoshis). Returns a Lightning invoice for immediate payment.

tools.name: buy_trajectory
tools.description: Purchase a complete 12-week Corpus Systemics recovery trajectory via Bitcoin Lightning Network (150 satoshis). Returns a Lightning invoice.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: catalog · Public sink: catalog, assess.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: catalog · Public sink: catalog, assess

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
